title: Insurance Claim Services Dwelling Release: Water Job Cost by Job Status
content:
Q. How is the Water Damage Mitigation job's cost measured for the insured's dwelling release on an Insurance Claim Services file?

A. The water job cost is measured as follows: when the water job is closed, by its final invoice amount less the billing error, duplicate line and goodwill credits posted on it, because the credits of a closed job are final and lower the price the insured incurred; when the job is invoiced and not closed, by its final invoice amount, because its credits are not final until the job closes; otherwise by every charge posted on the job other than late fees and card surcharges.

Q. Which credits are taken off a closed job's invoice?

A. Every billing error, duplicate line and goodwill adjustment credit posted on the job.

| Water job status | Water job cost taken as |
|---|---|
| closed | final invoice amount less billing error, duplicate line and goodwill credits |
| invoiced | final invoice amount |
| any other | every charge posted on the job other than late fees and card surcharges |

*Hypothetical:* final invoice 11240.00, credits of 180.00 (billing error) and 85.00 (goodwill). Closed: 10975.00. Invoiced: 11240.00.
